mapper.insert:
insert into basket_team_season_stat ( season_id, stage_id, team_id, games, wins, losses, points_for, points_against, avg_points, avg_points_against, avg_rebounds, avg_assists, avg_steals, avg_blocks, avg_turnovers, field_goal_pct, three_point_pct, free_throw_pct, win_rate, last_calculated_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete ) values
( #{item.seasonId}, #{item.stageId}, #{item.teamId}, #{item.games}, #{item.wins}, #{item.losses}, #{item.pointsFor}, #{item.pointsAgainst}, #{item.avgPoints}, #{item.avgPointsAgainst}, #{item.avgRebounds}, #{item.avgAssists}, #{item.avgSteals}, #{item.avgBlocks}, #{item.avgTurnovers}, #{item.fieldGoalPct}, #{item.threePointPct}, #{item.freeThrowPct}, #{item.winRate}, #{item.lastCalculatedTime}, now(), now(), 0 )
mapper.select: select count(1) from basket_team_season_stat where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId}
select max(last_calculated_time) from basket_team_season_stat where is_delete = 0 and season_id = #{seasonId}

select s.id, s.season_id as seasonId, s.stage_id as stageId, s.team_id as teamId, t.team_no as teamNo, t.team_name as teamName, t.short_name as shortName, lf.access_url as logoUrl, s.games, s.wins, s.losses, s.avg_points as avgPoints, s.avg_points_against as avgPointsAgainst, s.avg_rebounds as avgRebounds, s.avg_assists as avgAssists, s.avg_steals as avgSteals, s.avg_blocks as avgBlocks, s.field_goal_pct as fieldGoalPct, s.three_point_pct as threePointPct, s.free_throw_pct as freeThrowPct, s.win_rate as winRate from basket_team_season_stat s left join basket_team t on t.id = s.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = t.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0 where s.is_delete = 0 and s.season_id = #{seasonId} and s.stage_id = #{stageId}
